name: gh-gemini-review-loop
description: Run the gemini-code-assist PR review loop: wait, fetch actionable threads, fix, push, re-request review. Capped by preference, severity-aware, auditable.

interface.shortDescription: Turn Gemini Code Assist PR comments into a capped fix loop.
interface.longDescription: Run an opinionated Gemini Code Assist PR loop from Codex: wait for review activity, read real GitHub review-thread state, fix actionable comments, verify with repo-aware checks, push, request re-review, and stop at a configurable cap.
